title: [3.x] RenderItemState constructor reset() prev_distance_field uninitialized
body:
### Tested versions

3.6.3-rc
3.x
Linux GLES2 and GLES3



### System information

CachyOS - Godot 3.6.3-rc - GLES2 - dedicated RX9070xt

### Issue description

RenderItemState constructs itself through reset(), but reset() omits the bool prev_distance_field. The GLES2 batcher later reads that indeterminate value before writing it, producing UBSan’s “invalid value for type bool” report.

  The separate local ris.prev_distance_field = false does not initialize the persistent _render_item_state member. The appropriate fix is therefore one line in RenderItemState::reset():

  prev_distance_field = false;


I run the UBSan for my own code to catch my own errors. but this time it seems it wasn't my error it was upstream godot's error so here is the report so that you can go fix it



### Steps to reproduce

build godot 3.x branch on linux and run UBSAN for GLES2 and GLES3 paths to catch use before initialize errors



### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

_render_item_state is constructed during renderer setup, leaving prev_distance_field uninitialized. The invalid read occurs later when the GLES2 batcher processes its first canvas item through try_join_item().

  Therefore:

  - Any windowed GLES2 project that renders at least one 2D/Control/canvas item with batching enabled should reproduce it.
  - A blank project, pure 3D scene, disabled batching, or --no-window may not.
  - An unarmed editor should reproduce it because the editor UI contains many canvas items.

  So a tiny unarmed GLES2 project containing one ColorRect is the cleanest control.

while i was making the reproduction, it looks like there are also some thirdparty/nanosvg out-of-bounds in the reports too

the reset() and the join_batch_break = false live in batch_canvas_render_items_begin(), and the uninitialized read is reached via batch_canvas_render_items_end() -> join_sorted_items()

I asked AI to rip out all my custom stuff and make a minimal reproduction project :
[godot3-renderitemstate-ubsan.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31090693/godot3-renderitemstate-ubsan.zip)
It was made against 9b7024795133032f6c0e225fab31978bd83fbefa and includes the single line patch to set prev_distance_field = false so you can easily accept it
